{{Quote|I'm recommending this brave Jedi army for the Republic's top military honor. You've all earned it.|General Suthra, on the Jedi forces|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] '''Jedi''' served as a member of a detachment of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sent to aid the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] in battling the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Empire. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], the Twi'lek and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] Jedi worked under the Hero of [[Tython/Legends|Tython's]] command to stop the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tol Braga]] from [[Death/Legends|massacring]] thousands of civilians as a sacrifice for the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] to start a deadly [[Sith Emperor's ritual|dark side ritual]]. After Braga's plans were halted, the Jedi remained to fight the Empire's invasion of Corellia.

==Biography==
{{Quote|These young Jedi are unprepared for what lies ahead. Those of us with battlefield experience will share our knowledge while you're gone.|Unaw Aharo about the Outer Rim Jedi|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] was inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and underwent [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] sometime before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was stationed in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] when he was among those summoned by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], which was currently the site of a fierce [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] between the forces of the Republic and the Empire, and the Twi'lek joined a group of Jedi who were tasked with aiding the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] in stopping the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tol Braga]] from instigating massive civilian casualties. By doing so, Braga would allow his master, the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], to begin a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith Emperor's ritual|ritual]] and thereby consume all life in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
[[File:CorelliaTwilekJedi-SWTOR.png|thumb|left|150px|The Twi'lek Jedi on Corellia]]
Upon arriving on Corellia, the Twi'lek rendezvoused with the rest of the Outer Rim Jedi at the [[Socorro Freight building]], a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] base under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rikdine]], but the Hero of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]&mdash;who had been appointed [[Supreme Commander (Jedi)|Supreme Commander]] of all Jedi forces on Corellia&mdash;soon ordered the Knight's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], [[Unaw Aharo]], and the other Jedi to move to the [[Labor Valley]] district.<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> There, the Outer Rim Jedi were dispatched to liberate the weapons factories of corporate official [[Magremme Thrakus]], securing a valuable source of munitions for the Republic while the Hero of Tython foiled a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] attempt to detonate a [[chemical bomb]] in the region.<ref name="Death Cloud">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Death Cloud|Corellia}}</ref> The Twi'lek and the other Jedi were then sent to the [[Axial Park]] district, where the Hero directed them to raid several [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] camps in the area to free wrongfully [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] at the behest of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jol Zackin]].<ref name="Firestorm">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Firestorm|Corellia}}</ref>

As the battle in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] heated up, the Jedi worked with the forces of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] to distract the Imperial forces in the area while the Hero infiltrated the Imperial [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] [[Eclipse (Harrower-class)|''Eclipse'']] above the [[City/Legends|city]] and prevented Braga from detonating the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and destroying much of Coronet. After the fighting, the Hero assigned the Outer Rim Jedi to work with Suthra while the Knight departed for a [[Dromund Kaas operation|final confrontation]] with the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]],<ref name="Mutual">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Mutual Assured Destruction|Corellia}}</ref> and the Twi'lek and the other Jedi helped the Republic achieve victory in the Battle of Corellia.<ref name="Fall of Corellia">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Fall of Corellia|Vaiken Spacedock}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
[[File:CorelliaTwilekJediLightsaber-SWTOR.png|thumb|right|70px|The Twi'lek's lightsaber]]
A [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-skinned Twi'lek with blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], the Jedi wore silver, gray, and gray-green [[Armor/Legends|armor]] into battle on Corellia and wielded a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]].<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I wish I had good news, but the general's mission was not successful. He didn't have the forces he needed. They put up a good fight, but the enemy had superior numbers. There were no survivors.|[[Erris Wyum]], if the Outer Rim Jedi are dead|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
This Twi'lek Jedi is one of several unnamed background characters who appear during the Jedi Knight class storyline in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. The Jedi appears in the mission "Jedi Commander"<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> and will also appear in the final Corellia mission, "Mutual Assured Destruction," if the player has chosen only [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] options in the last few missions. If the player chooses the dark side options while directing the Jedi in the missions "Death Cloud" and "Firestorm," then many of the Outer Rim Jedi will [[Death/Legends|die]] and not appear in "Mutual Assured Destruction." This will also result in the death of General Suthra, as he lacks the numbers to defeat the Imperials in the Government District.<ref name="Mutual" /> However, as the Jedi Knight is a Republic character and therefore assumed to only take the moral light side options,<ref name="Light Side">This article assumes that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] classes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' choose the options that provide the most [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] alignment points.</ref> the Twi'lek is assumed to have survived.<ref name="Mutual" />
